# ScramSchedules

*Common*

Runs code or script functions later, after a number of ticks, from `c.getSchedules()`. A run with an ID can be stopped before it starts.

## Methods

### execute {#execute}

::: member

Runs a function of a script after a number of ticks with the same entities and values as this context: the context is copied now, with its subject, object and values, and the script gets the copy.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | task ID, to stop it with [`stop(String)`](#stop); tasks with the same ID all run |
| `script` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | script ID of the same side |
| `function` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | function name |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks to wait (20 ticks are a second); 0 runs it at the end of the current tick |

:::

### execute {#execute-2}

::: member

Runs a function of a script after a number of ticks, see [`execute(String, String, String, int)`](#execute); the task gets a random ID.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `script` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | script ID of the same side |
| `function` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | function name |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks to wait (20 ticks are a second); 0 runs it at the end of the current tick |

:::

### execute {#execute-3}

::: member

Runs the `main` function of a script after a number of ticks, see [`execute(String, String, String, int)`](#execute).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `script` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | script ID of the same side |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks to wait (20 ticks are a second); 0 runs it at the end of the current tick |

:::

### execute {#execute-4}

::: member

Runs a function after a number of ticks; errors in it are logged.

```js
c.getSchedules().execute("countdown", function () {
    c.send("Go!");
}, 60);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | task ID, to stop it with [`stop(String)`](#stop); tasks with the same ID all run |
| `runnable` | `Function` | function to run |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks to wait (20 ticks are a second); 0 runs it at the end of the current tick |

:::

### execute {#execute-5}

::: member

Runs a function after a number of ticks with a random task ID; errors in it are logged.

```js
c.getSchedules().execute(function () {
    c.send("Three seconds later");
}, 60);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `runnable` | `Function` | function to run |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks to wait (20 ticks are a second); 0 runs it at the end of the current tick |

:::

### stop {#stop}

::: member

Cancels waiting tasks with an ID; tasks of any script of this side can be stopped.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | task ID; an unknown ID does nothing |

:::

### getIds {#getids}

::: member

**Returns** `List<String>` — new list of the IDs of all waiting tasks of this side, from every script

:::

### getMap {#getmap}

::: member

**Returns** `Map<String,Integer>` — new map of the waiting tasks of this side, from every script: task ID to the ticks left

:::
